thread.title: Technology sector downgraded as earnings revisions trend looks 'downright awful'--Morgan Stanley

author: morningstar.com
title: Technology sector downgraded as earnings revisions trend looks 'downright awful'--Morgan Stanley
text:
Investors should take profits on technology sector stocks, suggested Morgan Stanley's U.S. equity strategy team, as the sector was downgraded to equal weight from overweight on weakening earnings revisions. Equity strategist Michael Wilson said when there is doubt about the direction of the broader stock market, he always looks to "relative earnings revision breadth," or which sectors have the highest percentages of upward or downward earnings revisions. In that sense, he said technology does not look very good. "In fact, it looks downright awful," Wilson wrote in a research note. He said the downward earnings revisions have been driving primarily by semiconductors, which have been underperforming since November, as the "poor sell thru" of Apple Inc.'s (AAPL) new iPhone has resulting in excess inventory. The SPDR Technology Select Sector ETF (XLK) slipped 0.2% in morning trade, while the PHLX Semiconductor Index shed 0.8%. Over the past three months, the technology ETF has gained 4.5% and the chip index has tacked on 0.6%, while the S&P 500 has gained 6.1%.
